隐私政策

更新日期 / Updated: 2026-09-29 · App Store 版本

本 App 的牌局和 AI 对战在设备上运行。当前版本没有账号注册、广告或跨 App 跟踪功能。

设备上的数据

App 在设备上保存设置、牌局记录、生涯筹码、成就、练习次数与续局状态，用于恢复游戏和执行次数限制。这些游戏数据不会由 App 主动上传到开发者服务器。设备备份是否包含这些数据取决于你的系统设置。

导出与联系

只有在你主动导出牌局并选择分享目标时，牌局文件才会交给相应的 App 或服务。主动联系开发者时，你发送的邮箱地址和邮件内容会用于处理你的问题；请不要发送与问题无关的敏感信息。

管理数据

你可以在设置中清空牌局记录。清空生涯会按界面说明重置资金，但保留成就、已解锁档位和免费重置使用记录；它不等于删除全部数据。练习次数和免费重置次数保存在设备上。

隐私问题

如对数据处理有疑问，请使用设置右下角的“联系我们”入口。

mixmin2000@gmail.com

本支持网站

本网站不设置广告或分析脚本，也不要求注册。托管服务为交付网页和维护安全，可能处理 IP 地址、浏览器信息和访问日志。通过邮件提交的信息由邮件服务商传递。

Privacy Policy

Hands and AI opponents run on your device. The current version has no account registration, advertising or cross-app tracking.

Data on your device

The app stores settings, hand history, career chips, achievements, practice allowances and saved tables on your device to restore games and enforce usage limits. The app does not automatically upload this game data to developer servers. Inclusion in device backups depends on your system settings.

Exporting and contacting us

A hand file is passed to another app or service only when you choose to export and share it. When you contact the developer, the email address and message you send are used to handle your request. Please avoid sending unrelated sensitive information.

Managing data

You can clear hand history in Settings. Resetting your career restores funds as described in the app, while keeping achievements, unlocked stakes and the free-reset usage record; it does not delete all data. Practice and free-reset allowances are stored on your device.

Privacy questions

For questions about data handling, use Contact us in the lower-right corner of Settings.

mixmin2000@gmail.com

This support website

This site uses no advertising or analytics scripts and requires no registration. The hosting provider may process IP addresses, browser information and access logs to deliver and secure the site. Messages you send are transmitted by email providers.
